reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and get most of this done by copy-pasting into LinkedIn and our CRM. I've never heard of FLUGIA and I'm not wiring our CRM and Google Workspace into a company that might not exist in two years, so maybe I'd poke at the free plan but I'm not paying.
objection: Who is FLUGIA and will they still be around in two years? If I spend weeks feeding them our knowledge base and connecting our tools and they fold, I've wasted the time and our data sits somewhere I can't control. And I still don't see what it does that my ChatGPT subscription doesn't.
would_change_my_mind: A month-long trial on our own CRM, plus references from a couple of Belgian or Dutch SMEs my size, showing it actually runs follow-ups and posts on its own and saves me real hours compared with ChatGPT.
